title: CAMA Mean-vs-Sum Aggregation Causal Diagnosis on rel-f1 (5 methods × 2 tasks × 5 seeds)
summary: Demo notebook for CAMA (Cardinality-Aware Moment Aggregation) mean-vs-sum aggregation experiment on rel-f1 dataset. Demonstrates: (1) CAMA/SumCAMA/UngatedMoment PyG Aggregation modules with zero-init unit tests (torch_geometric required, runs on Colab), (2) effective rank measurement via SVD spectral entropy, (3) statistical analysis with Cohen's d bootstrap 95% CI and 2-way ANOVA interaction tests on 50 pre-computed experiment results (5 methods x 2 tasks x 5 seeds), (4) four-panel visualization showing test metrics, effect size forest plot, effective rank comparison, and training loss curves. Core statistical analysis and visualization run without torch dependency; CAMA module demo activates automatically on Colab where torch is pre-installed.
